box.highlights: Floyd 46, Lindenhurst 28: AJ Cannet completed 6 of 12 passes for 125 yards and two touchdowns and ran for 33 yards and two more scores to lead host Floyd (2-0) in Suffolk I. Ja'Quan Thomas had 22 carries for 147 yards and two TDs. Josh Jordan caught two passes for 28 yards and a TD and added an interception Geo Alvarez caught two passes for 68 yards and a touchdown and returned a fumble 16 yards for a TD. Alvarez added five tackles and an interception. Marty Pusey caught touchdown passes of 43, 45 and 21 yards for Lindenhurst (1-1). Reece Wrightington threw for four TDs, inlcuding a 53-yard score to Christian Aquino.

Floyd 36, Commack 14: Ja'Quan Thomas rushed for 275 yards on 26 carries and three touchdowns to lead visitor Floyd (3-0) in Suffolk I. He also converted a two-point attempt. AJ Cannet completed 10 of 17 passes for 178 yards and tw touchdowns. Both scores went to wide receiver Geo Alvarez, who caught three passes for 121 yards. Zamari Wilkins racked up 12 tackles and two tackles for loss. Commack drops to 1-2.

Floyd 48, Sachem East 20: AJ Cannet completed 9 of 12 passes for 150 yards and 1 touchdown while adding 38 rushing yards and two more touchdowns on five carries for Floyd (4-0) on the road in Suffolk I. Ja'Quan Thomas toted the ball 19 times, finishing with 220 yards and three touchdowns. He added a catch for 14 yards. Geo Alvarez caught three passes for 59 yards and a touchdown. AJ Vurchio rushed for a 40-yard touchdown and connected with Gianni Spinelli for a 48-yard passing touchdown for Sachem East (1-3). Spinelli also rushed for an 8-yard score.

Floyd 48, Sachem North 28: AJ Cannet completed 11 of 16 passes for 200 yards and a score for Floyd (5-1) in Suffolk I. Running back Ja'Quan Thomas rushed for 301 yards and four touchdowns on 30 carries and wideout Geo Alvarez caught six passes for 102 yards. Defensive lineman Aaron Fisher collected 13 tackles, four tackles for loss, and three sacks. Luke LaRocca threw for two touchdowns of 69 and 25 yards and running back Lucas Singleton rushed for two scores of 1 and 45 yards for Sachem North (1-5).

Floyd 34, Whitman 3:  AJ Cannet completed 7 of 11 passes for 142 yards and two touchdowns and added 24 rushing yards and a 7-yard touchdown on the ground to lead host Floyd (6-1) in Suffolk I. Ja'Quan Thomas rushed for 131 yards and a 45-yard touchdown on 16 carries and Josh Jordan caught three passes for 119 yards and two touchdowns. Zamari Wilkins picked up five tackles, two tackles for loss, and one sack. Mike Mannino had a 37-yard field goal for Whitman (3-4).

Floyd 42, Connetquot 30: Ja'Quan Thomas ran for 241 yards and three touchdowns on 34 carries to lead visiting Floyd (7-1) in Suffolk I. AJ Cannet completed 8 of 14 passes for 197 yards and two touchdowns and ran for 1-yard touchdown. Geo Alvarez had four catches for 98 yards and a touchdown. Aisays Wallace had 12 tackles, two tackles for loss and a pass breakup. Vinny Feraca threw for 247 yards and two touchdowns, ran for 52 yards and had an interception for Connetquot (6-2). Andrew Amarando had seven catches for 117 yards and a touchdown. Lucas Weaver had 23 tackles.

Floyd 43, Sachem East 22: Ja'Quan Thomas rushed for 303 yards and six touchdowns on 23 carries as host No. 1 Floyd defeated No. 8 Sachem East in the Suffolk Division I quarterfinals. He also ran in a two-point conversion. Zamari Wilkins had 10 tackles, including three sacks. AJ Cannet completed 9 of 10 passes for 75 yards. A.J. Vurchio had two touchdowns runs for Sachem East.

Ja'Quan Thomas rushed for 232 yards and three touchdowns on 30 carries to lead No. 1 Floyd over No. 4 Sachem North in the Suffolk Division I semfinals. AJ Cannet completed 8 of 12 passes for 135 yards and two touchdowns and Josh Jordan caught three passes for 63 yards and a 33-yard score. Aaron Fisher and Jayden Johnson each had nine tackles, including three for a loss and two sacks. Jake Rivera had nine tackles, including four for a loss and a sack. Floyd will face No. 3 Ward Melville in the final at 7 p.m. Saturday at Stony Brook University.

Floyd 34, Ward Melville 6: Ja'Quan Thomas rushed for 261 yards and five touchdowns on 30 carries to lead Floyd to its second straight Division I title and 15th overall. Jake Rivera had nine tackles and a sack, and Aaron Fisher had eight tackles for Floyd (10-1). Ward Melville finished at 9-2.

Massapequa 42, Floyd 40
Tyler Villalta rushed for 246 yards and three touchdowns on 39 carries to lead Massapequa to its third Long Island Class I title in the last four years. Massapequa (11-1) won its last 11 games after an opening day loss. Ja'Quan Thomas of Floyd rushed for 172 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries. He also scored two 2-point conversions. AJ Cannet completed 10 of 20 passes for 202 yards and two touchdowns for the Colonials (10-2).
